Q5217.reason: Under UCC 2-207, an order confirmation expressly conditioned on the new loading charge is a counteroffer, and Rainmaking never accepted it.

Q8260.reason: Water is formed only when oxygen accepts electrons at the end of the electron transport chain, so its production stops as soon as oxygen is cut off.

Q5585.reason: The question is leading on direct examination of the calling party’s own witness, who is not adverse, so the objection should be sustained.
